title: Trailer for my demo - Models, Textures, Animations and Coding all AI assisted.  I made this in 4 months.
author: redtigerpro
selftext: I am experienced in Unity and have programmed in the past. The last time I attempted this demo, around 10 years ago, I ran into so many walls with coding that I just couldn't keep going.  Now with AI, I can figure out the logic and it's there for me with the syntax.  It helps with debugging.  I'm using meshy for game models and props.

replies.body: Hrm...funny isn't exactly what I was going for o.O

comments.author: Katwazere
comments.body:
I'm afraid it just looks like a asset flip and a make a  survival game tutorial series kinda project. You might want to go back to the drawing board and figure out what the plan is.

I personally recommend starting with a game design document so that you can work out why people would want to play the game. Ai should build on a plan, not be directing it.

Also style is a cheat code, if your game looks distinctive then it will be more likely to get players instead of generic realistic fantasy art style that's been perfected by skyrim 15 years ago

replies.author: redtigerpro
replies.body:
It's an open world game.  There are no Town NPCs to tell you what to do or where to go, so you build your character and explore the world. You build skills, gather resources, create goods.  It's a true RPG, so you make the story.  You'll live...and Die.  And from there...well you'll have to find out...

You can get more info from the [website](https://redtigerpro.com/death-taxes-game)

That being said, this is only an Alpha demo so much is not implemented but we are working hard and want to gauge interest.
